class TestCache:
    def test_maxsize_validation(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            Cache(-1)
        Cache(0)  # zero is allowed

    def test_basic_setitem_getitem(self):
        c = Cache(maxsize=2)
        c["a"] = 1
        c["b"] = 2
        assert c["a"] == 1
        assert c["b"] == 2
        assert len(c) == 2
        assert "a" in c
        assert "z" not in c

    def test_missing_key(self):
        c = Cache(maxsize=2)
        with pytest.raises(KeyError):
            c["missing"]

    def test_get(self):
        c = Cache(maxsize=2)
        c["a"] = 1
        assert c.get("a") == 1
        assert c.get("b") is None
        assert c.get("b", 99) == 99

    def test_pop(self):
        c = Cache(maxsize=2)
        c["a"] = 1
        assert c.pop("a") == 1
        assert "a" not in c
        with pytest.raises(KeyError):
            c.pop("a")
        assert c.pop("a", 42) == 42

    def test_setdefault(self):
        c = Cache(maxsize=2)
        assert c.setdefault("a", 5) == 5
        assert c["a"] == 5
        assert c.setdefault("a", 7) == 5

        c = Cache(maxsize=10)
        assert c.maxsize == 10
        assert c.currsize == 0
        c["a"] = 1
        assert c.currsize == 1

    def test_getsizeof_default(self):
        assert Cache.getsizeof(object()) == 1

    def test_custom_getsizeof(self):
        c = Cache(maxsize=10, getsizeof=len)
        c["a"] = "hello"
        assert c.currsize == 5
        c["b"] = "xy"
        assert c.currsize == 7

    def test_value_too_large(self):
        c = Cache(maxsize=2)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            c["big"] = "value"  # size 1, but maxsize 2, so this is allowed...

    def test_value_too_large_err(self):
        c = Cache(maxsize=2, getsizeof=len)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            c["x"] = "abc"  # size 3 > 2

    def test_negative_size(self):
        c = Cache(maxsize=2, getsizeof=lambda v: -1)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):

        c["b"] = 2
